verdict: The revised work retains a complete silent baseline. Visual refinements address meaning directly; no audio addition, audio control or sonic test is required for this scope.

brand/animation-v5/index.html; source scan of motion.js, reel.js and studio.js

resolvedIssues: Observed: sad-worried.png no longer shows the former open green smile at the sampled 200–300ms transition. Retaining a concerned expression supports silent emotional continuity without an explanatory cue.

Observed: poses.png separates the lower thinking mitten from chin contact and lowers/separates focused mittens. Interpretation: this creates a clearer hierarchy of gestures without enlarging the character.
Observed in source: the body now has a nonzero authored descent tangent at 900ms while the wing beat reverses. This resolves the mathematical stop, not yet the question of perceived weight.
Observed: local Feeling selection and previous/next controls add visual navigation. The inspected implementation still has no audio path; these controls therefore grant no hidden sound consent.

findings.claim: The updated contact sheets establish poses and the source establishes timing changes. Neither proves that the hop, antenna lead or comic pause reads naturally at continuous playback speed. This is not a sonic defect.
findings.fix: Review the updated continuous silent clip at its intended size when available; preserve silence even if a visual timing revision is needed.
findings.verification: Describe the observed continuous rise, descent and landing separately from subjective warmth; do not infer audience appeal or add a landing sound merely to create weight.

limits: No audio exists to assess and none was heard. No updated continuous clip was watched. No browser operation, listener study or intended-site usability test was performed. Earlier optional sonic ideas remain uncommissioned experiments, including material choice; silence has no unfinished audio requirement.
